question: Where does Shiva-knowledge shine among scripture students?
premises: Shiva-knowledge does not shine among those engaged in other scriptures
the Siddhantin is not in the left
he is not in the right in our opinion
inference: Shiva-knowledge is not found among other-scripture students, and the Siddhantin is neither left nor right
uncertainties: vāme and dakṣe may be technical ritual directions
plain_english: Shiva-knowledge does not shine among those engaged in other scriptures; the Siddhantin is not in the left, nor is he in the right, in our opinion.
